title: Specializing AI for Regulated Industries - How Domyn Uses NVIDIA Nemotron
summary: Domyn is specializing NVIDIA Nemotron-based models for regulated industries that need ownership, governance, transparency, and auditability rather than black-box deployment. Its pipeline combines model compression, multilingual continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning to build a 263B-parameter reasoning model plus smaller domain-specific models, targeting enterprise tasks such as text-to-SQL, knowledge graph extraction, and safety classification.

extra.full_text: Regulated industries require full ownership,control and customization of the models they deploy with end-to-end governance, transparency, and auditability. This livestream explores how Domyn has built and specialized its own models, including a 263B-parameter reasoning model purpose-built for regulated industries and smaller models for specific domains and tasks. We'll walk through the training pipeline: model compression, multilingual continual pretraining, supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, leveraging the NVIDIA open source ecosystem. Learn how this approach delivers state-of-the-art results on enterprise tasks like text-to-SQL, knowledge graph extraction, and safety classification, and enable AI that you can own, control and customize, built for the demands of regulated industries.

summary: 로봇 디자인 is an introductory book on designing robots that coexist with humans, moving from basic definitions and design elements to HRI-oriented interaction and UX practice. summary: Burns & McDonnell and Gritt have formed a strategic partnership to evaluate and deploy AI-enabled robotics for large-scale solar construction projects. Gritt’s approach combines AI and robotics with attachments for standard construction equipment, aiming to automate labor-intensive field tasks while improving safety, schedule predictability, and support for construction crews as energy infrastructure demand grows.

title: 日 도호쿠대, 대벌레에서 영감 얻은 6족보행 로봇 개발
summary: Tohoku University and VISTEC researchers developed a six-legged robot inspired by stick insects that can learn walking principles from only a few observed steps. The robot began walking in about an hour and could traverse uneven terrain, while also adapting when one leg was missing, pointing to possible use in disaster-response robots.

title: 中 푸두 로보틱스, 자율지게차 MP2000 출시
summary: Pudu Robotics has launched the MP2000, an AI-enabled autonomous pallet handler aimed at high-frequency, heavy-load transport in crowded manufacturing and logistics sites. It extends the company’s AMR line into warehouse and factory pallet loading and unloading, using 3D lidar and depth cameras to localize pallets and adjust its approach path in real time, with a reported 20-second pallet pickup or fork-insertion cycle.

title: “AI가 이제 현실 세계를 움직인다”…앤트로픽, '모델 하드웨어 표준(MHS)’ 프리뷰 공개
summary: Anthropic previewed the Model Hardware Standard, a proposed interface for AI agents to connect to and control physical lab and manufacturing equipment in a standardized way. The initial release is limited to science labs and advanced manufacturers, where Anthropic plans to work with early partners on safety evaluations and usage guidelines before broader deployment.
